title: Aromatic Crispy Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Tunisian dish featuring crispy lamb, sweet currants, and a rich glaze, served in a terracotta dish. This recipe is a perfect hangover cure and a great example of Mediterranean cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and brown the lamb pieces on all sides.
Transfer the lamb to a terracotta dish and add the chopped onion.
Bake the lamb and onion in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together honey and lemon juice to make the glaze.
After 30 minutes, brush the glaze over the lamb and onion.
Add the currants to the terracotta dish and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
